## PLEASE NOTE THAT I RUN TWO SEPERATE DATA FILES ON THIS SCRIPT, WILL NEED TO CLEAR THE ENVIRONMENT EACH TIME SWAPPING BETWEEN FILES

## Loading Packages and Datafiles - BIFoR

```{r warning=FALSE, message = FALSE}
rm(list=ls())
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(plotrix)
library(car)
library(vegan)




# IMPORT DATA FILE OR SET WORKING DIRECTORY

# IMPORT DATA FILED CALLED : Master_BIFOR_Metabolomics_Data_NERC_Submission_May4_2026

data<-Master_BIFOR_Metabolomics_Data_NERC_Submission_May4_2026

str(data)

ncol(data)

meta.data<-data[,c(4:1961)] # TO FILTER OUT METADATA

ncol(meta.data)

data$f.Treatment<-factor(data$Treatment)

```

## Analysis and Figure

```{r}
meta.PCA<- rda(log10(meta.data+1),scale=TRUE) 
plot(meta.PCA)
summary(meta.PCA)

set.seed(123)
adonis2(scale(log10(meta.data+1))~ f.Treatment, method = "euclidean",data=data)

scores.pca.meta<-vegan::scores(meta.PCA, choices=c(1,2), scaling=3) 
  
Sample.meta.PCA <- data.frame(scores.pca.meta$sites) 

Sample.meta.PCA <-data.frame(Sample.meta.PCA,data$f.Treatment)
colnames(Sample.meta.PCA)[3]<-"f.Treatment"

BIFoR.Meta.Fig <- ggplot(Sample.meta.PCA, aes(x = PC1, y =PC2)) + 
  geom_point(aes(fill=f.Treatment),size=5,alpha = 0.7, color="black",shape=21) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("darkseagreen3","orange2"),labels = c("Ambient", "Elevated"))+
  labs(title="Initial Litter Metabolomics",
       x="PC1 (26.59% Variance Explained)",
       y="PC2 (14.01% Variance Explained)", fill="Environment")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(color = "grey2", size =17),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color = "grey2", size =15),
        axis.title.y = element_text(color = "grey2", size = 17),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = "grey2", size =15),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "grey2", size =15),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "grey2", size =17),
         legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(size=21))
BIFoR.Meta.Fig 

#jpeg("~/documents/BIFoR.Meta.Fig.jpeg", width=1300, height=900, res = 150, quality = 200)
#BIFoR.Meta.Fig 
#dev.off()
```

## Loading Packages and Datafiles - O3HP

```{r}
rm(list=ls())
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(plotrix)
library(car)
library(vegan)


# IMPORT DATA FILE OR SET WORKING DIRECTORY

# IMPORT DATA FILED CALLED : Master_OHP_Metabolomics_Data_NERC_Submission_May4_2026

data<-Master_OHP_Metabolomics_Data_NERC_Submission_May4_2026

str(data)
colnames(data)

ncol(data)

meta.data<-data[,-c(1:3)]
colnames(meta.data)

ncol(meta.data)

data$f.Treatment<-factor(data$Treatment)
```


## Analysis and Figure

```{r}

meta.PCA<- rda(log10(meta.data+1),scale=TRUE) 
plot(meta.PCA)
summary(meta.PCA)


set.seed(123)
adonis2(scale(log10(meta.data+1))~ f.Treatment, method = "euclidean",data=data)

scores.pca.meta<-vegan::scores(meta.PCA, choices=c(1,2), scaling=3) 
  
Sample.meta.PCA <- data.frame(scores.pca.meta$sites) 

Sample.meta.PCA <-data.frame(Sample.meta.PCA,data$f.Treatment)
colnames(Sample.meta.PCA)[3]<-"f.Treatment"

title.expression <- expression(O[3] ~ variable ~ label)

OHP.Meta.Fig <- ggplot(Sample.meta.PCA, aes(x = PC1, y =PC2)) + 
  geom_point(aes(fill=f.Treatment),size=5,alpha = 0.7, color="black",shape=21) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("slategray3","palevioletred1"),labels = c("Ambient", "Drought"))+
  labs(title="Initial Litter Metabolomics",
       x="PC1 (26.27% Variance Explained)",
       y="PC2 (16.67% Variance Explained)", fill="Environment")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(color = "grey2", size =17),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color = "grey2", size =15),
        axis.title.y = element_text(color = "grey2", size = 17),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = "grey2", size =15),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "grey2", size =15),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "grey2", size =17),
         legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(size=21))
OHP.Meta.Fig


#jpeg("~/documents/OHP.Meta.Fig.jpeg", width=1300, height=900, res = 150, quality = 200)
#OHP.Meta.Fig 
#dev.off()
```
